# Requirements Quality Checklist: Ponytail na stack oficial

**Purpose**: Validar completude, clareza, consistência e mensurabilidade dos requisitos de detecção do plugin ponytail (kind `harness-plugin`), instalação delegada por runtime e documentação deste repositório, antes de `tasks`
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: revisor do ciclo v4 (etapas `analyze` e `review`)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the four detection outcomes (present, outdated, missing, undetermined) each defined with the condition that produces them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, contracts/dependency-report.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is the source of truth for installation state specified per harness, including the environment variable that relocates it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, research.md R2]
- [x] CHK003 Are the remediation commands specified per harness, in order, for both `missing` and `outdated`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, contracts/dependency-manifest-entry.md]
- [x] CHK004 Is the behaviour under `--require-dependencies` and under `GRILL_SKIP_DEPENDENCIES=1` stated for this dependency? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Are the eight version points that the bump must touch enumerated, and is the bump magnitude fixed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, plan.md §Bump]
- [x] CHK006 Are the documentation deliverables enumerated with the content each must carry (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, settings.json, SKILL.md, README)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011..FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Is the manifest validation rule for the new `install_by_runtime` field (allowed keys, argv shape, error) specified? [Completeness, contracts/dependency-manifest-entry.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "presente" quantified as installed at version ≥ 4.9.0, distinct from "habilitado"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 Is the tie-break rule for multiple cached versions on Codex explicit (highest by version parse, `plugin.json` version over directory name)? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK010 Is the distinction between "arquivo/chave ausente → missing" and "arquivo ilegível → undetermined" stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, research.md R5]
- [x] CHK011 Is the `reason` text for each non-present outcome specified, so that reports are comparable across runs? [Clarity, contracts/dependency-report.md]
- [x] CHK012 Is the installation scope (`user`) stated, so that no consumer-project file is written? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, research.md R3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the spec's remediation requirement (FR-004) and the manifest contract's `install_by_runtime` sequences name the same commands in the same order? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, contracts/dependency-manifest-entry.md]
- [x] CHK014 Does the `undetermined` rule agree with the existing extension-registry semantics ("not observed" never becomes "missing", never installs)? [Consistency, research.md R5, data-model.md §Invariantes]
- [x] CHK015 Do the spec's scope exclusions (no enabled-state check, no CLI detection, no consumer writes) match ADR-0001, ADR-0003 and ADR-0004 in the work item? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Does the plan's Constitution Check list every clause of the constitution with a status, matching the work item's CONSTITUTION-CHECK? [Consistency, plan.md §Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can SC-001 (distinct and correct reports per environment per harness) be verified offline with fixtures rather than real installs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, quickstart.md §1]
